shared_elements: upright slab/stele with figural relief in registers
row of repeated figures in a horizontal band
human figures with raised or extended arms
framing border band along an edge
stacked tiers of imagery on a tall vertical field
justification: Both are tall upright slabs bearing figural imagery divided into stacked horizontal registers, with rows of repeated figures across an upper band and a framing/edging element, which gives a loose compositional echo. But the actual content differs almost completely: A shows profile animals (predator/canine, bird with long neck, snake-like and insect-like creatures) with crouching small human figures and a row of crouching beasts, while B shows a crowd of cloaked standing human figures with a boat and an interlace border; the drawing conventions (low naturalistic modelled relief vs flat silhouetted outline figures) are also unrelated.
